data.title: Anagram Values: The Right Value
data.statement: Several Scrabble players each have a hand of scrambled letters. For each player, find every dictionary word that is an exact anagram of their hand (uses all the letters, same counts). Among those, determine that player's best word: the one with the highest (or lowest, depending on mode) point value, with alphabetical order breaking ties. A player with no matching word is excluded from consideration. Finally, output every player whose best word's score matches the overall best (highest or lowest) among all players who had a valid word — there can be multiple winners if tied.

lastVersion.statementHTML:
Goal

Several Scrabble players each have a hand of scrambled letters. For each player, find every dictionary word that is an exact anagram of their hand (uses all the letters, same counts). Among those, determine that player's best word: the one with the highest (or lowest, depending on mode) point value, with alphabetical order breaking ties. A player with no matching word is excluded from consideration. Finally, output every player whose best word's score matches the overall best (highest or lowest) among all players who had a valid word — there can be multiple winners if tied.
Input
Line 1: mode (high or low)
Line 2: n (number of scrambled groups)
Next n lines: name hand (space-separated)
Line after: d (dictionary size)
Next d lines: dictionary words
Output
One line per winning player, in the same order they appeared in the input: name word. There is always at least one winning player.
Constraints
1 ≤ n ≤ 10
1 ≤ d ≤ 30
1 ≤ length of each hand/word ≤ 12
mode = high or low
Player names are unique, lowercase, no spaces
At least one player is guaranteed to have a valid (anagram-matching) word
Example
Input
high
2
alice tac
bob xof
3
cat
dog
fox
Output
bob fox
